reasoning_chain: Multiple callers (checkoutservice, frontend, recommendationservice) show slow calls converging on productcatalogservice, indicating productcatalogservice is the root cause.

productcatalogservice's own p95 latency is low (0.48ms), but callers see high latency (e.g., checkoutservice->productcatalogservice avg 25.79ms, frontend->productcatalogservice avg 20.56ms), indicating requests queue before processing, a sign of resource exhaustion.
CPU usage of productcatalogservice is 0.005 cores of 0.010 cores limit (47%), indicating CPU throttling due to very low CPU limit.
productcatalogservice pod was recently recreated 331s ago, coinciding with a configuration change reducing CPU limit from 200m to 10m, likely causing the resource exhaustion.
Other services have normal CPU usage and low latency, so the fault is isolated to productcatalogservice.
Latency propagates upward along the critical path: productcatalogservice delays checkoutservice, which delays frontend.
